description: Test feeder data for "Multi-period Distribution Optimal Power Flow with Intertemporal Constraints of Discrete Control Devices is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors João Rodrigo Muniz, Camila Alves. OpenDSS and JSON data for a modified IEEE 123-node feeder with load and PV generation data for a 24-h time horizon comprising 144 10-min intervals. The main grid in OpenDSS format is contained in the file ieee123.dss . This file was imported and transformed into JSON format using the Julia PowerModelsDistribution.jl package. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 870583 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
